package.name: unistat-kis-2011-2012-in-rdf-key-information-set-uk-universities
package.notes: Key Information Sets (KIS) are comparable sets of information about full or part time undergraduate courses and are designed to meet the information needs of prospective students (http://www.hefce.ac.uk/whatwedo/lt/publicinfo/kis/). This is a translation of the data provided for 2011/2012 in XML from HESA and Unistat (http://www.hesa.ac.uk/index.php?option=com_content&task=view&id=2609) as RDF/Linked Data, with a SPARQL endpoint
package.title: UNISTAT-KIS 2011/2012 in RDF (Key Information Set - UK Universities)
